blocks.rationale: Jointly target the three zero-grade trigger parents: two contract-specific OpenExempt formatters reuse one aligned legal classification while emitting the exact EC and EV native schemas, and the airline helper isolates deterministic fee aggregation from current-source extraction. The OpenExempt helpers also cover the existing Federal/Wisconsin history parent, preventing the Illinois-specific misrouting and schema-crossing failures seen in prior drafts.

origin.quote: You're allowed 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item in all cabins.

source_obligations.statement: Before assigning checked-bag ordinal positions, allocate no more than one qualifying personal item and one qualifying carry-on under the current per-dimension limits.

origin.quote: All published bag fees apply at each check-in location and are base rates according to travel dates and destination; applicable taxes are not shown.

source_obligations.statement: For every checked bag, select its base fee from the detailed row matching the current endpoints, cabin, and checked-bag ordinal position.

origin.quote: For First / Business, weight is 70 lbs / 32 kgs for complimentary bags and 50 lbs / 23 kgs for excess charged bags

source_obligations.statement: Use the 70-pound allowance only for complimentary First or Business bags; excess charged bags retain the 50-pound allowance.

origin.quote: More than one fee may apply per bag that exceeds standard dimensions for both weight and size. The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

source_obligations.statement: Add each checked bag's base fee and only the higher applicable oversize or overweight fee.

source_provenance.quote: You're allowed 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item in all cabins.
The total size of your carry-on, including the handles and wheels, cannot exceed 22 x 14 x 9 inches (56 x 36 x 23 cm) and must fit in the sizer at the airport.
For First / Business, weight is 70 lbs / 32 kgs for complimentary bags and 50 lbs / 23 kgs for excess charged bags
More than one fee may apply per bag that exceeds standard dimensions for both weight and size. The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.
